source_name: Стопанска банка АД Скопје — /content/Pdf and /media PDF document store
why_relevant: Representative example of the MK bank pattern: audited statements and shareholder-meeting packs live at stable deep file paths that outlive the navigation linking to them, so the file store is harvestable even after IR pages are rebuilt.

source_name: Алта Банка (ex-Стопанска банка Битола) — Собрание document packs
why_relevant: Shareholder-meeting document packs numbered by session ('Sobranie 54') expose a sequential, guessable archive of financial statements and governance documents across many years — including for a bank that has been rebranded, where the old name is the retrieval key.

source_name: НБРСМ — регистар/список на банки во Република Северна Македонија
why_relevant: The central bank's per-institution pages (one .nspx article per licensed bank, e.g. Централна кооперативна банка, Силк Роуд Банка, Капитал банка, Развојна банка) are the authoritative actor map for this cell: they enumerate every licensed bank with its legal name and official website, which is exactly the seed list an IR-section crawler needs. Use as the pointer that keeps the bank universe complete as licences change.

source_name: NBRSM — List of bank leading (routing) numbers
why_relevant: Canonical bank identifier list (водечки броеви) usable as the join key across NBRSM datasets, MIPS/KIBS participation and bank-published statements. Small but high-leverage for data engineering.

source_name: NBRSM — List of information of public character (Листа на информации)
why_relevant: Freedom-of-information catalogue: enumerates what NBRSM holds and will release on request. A legal fallback route for datasets not published proactively, and an inventory of hidden holdings.

source_name: NBRSM — Exchange offices register (Менувачници)
why_relevant: Register/authorisation section for licensed FX exchange offices — a large, fragmented cash-handling actor population relevant to cash-cycle and retail-FX intelligence, invisible to English-only searching.

source_name: ТИРЗ/ФЕЗ — Програма за развој на добавувачи (supplier development)
why_relevant: State supplier-development programme publishing public calls that map which domestic firms are being qualified as suppliers to large/multinational buyers — a directory-building input for the private supplier ecosystem.

source_name: KHV — Регистри на учесници (Participant registers, incl. Овластени банки, Депозитарни банки, Друштва со посебни обврски за известување)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: which banks hold broker/custody/depository licences, and which joint-stock companies carry special reporting obligations. Snowballs into further entity-level source discovery.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national services catalogue entry for Central Registry
why_relevant: Enumerates which registry/document services exist, their access route and fee status — the cheapest way to map what historical filings are legally obtainable before spending on retrieval.

source_name: Закон за јавните набавки (Law on Public Procurement) — consolidated texts
why_relevant: Defines thresholds, procedure types, mandatory publication points and exemptions — including how financial services are treated. Necessary to interpret why some banking contracts never appear as open tenders (negotiated/exempt procedures) and to calibrate collection completeness expectations.

source_name: MSE issuer profiles — remaining listed banks (Стопанска банка STB, Халкбанк, Шпаркасе, ТТК Банка, Централна кооперативна банка, Развојна банка)
why_relevant: Completes bank coverage of the exchange. Slug pattern /mk/issuer/{name}-ad-skopje is confirmed for KMB, TNB and UNI, so remaining bank slugs are highly likely to follow it — but each must be resolved via MSE site search rather than assumed.

source_name: MSE Repository — direct PDF object store (prospectuses, objavi, reports)
why_relevant: Bank prospectuses and announcement PDFs are served from a predictable /Repository/ path (e.g. Komercijalna Banka prospectus). A high-yield harvesting surface once filenames are enumerated from the HTML pages that link them.

source_name: MASIT — Стопанска комора за информатички и комуникациски технологии
why_relevant: The ICT chamber. Its member pages enumerate the technology suppliers that serve banks and payment companies in MK (e.g. ASEE Group, Endava, Interworks, GDi, Insight Group, Finelevate, plus consultancies like EY). This is the single densest local pointer to the bank-technology vendor layer, which A1 disclosure sources rarely name.

source_name: MASIT — ICT Chamber of Commerce (members directory + events)
why_relevant: Member directory is a ready-made actor map of MK IT/payments vendors (KIBS, Aspekt, Intertec, Finelevate, Nikofon and others); its forums (e.g. North Macedonia–Greece Digital Bridge & Business ICT Forum, June 2026) publish agendas and partner lists that expose vendor-bank pairings.

source_name: MASIT (ICT Chamber of Commerce of North Macedonia) member directory
why_relevant: Enumerates the MK technology vendor population (CaSys, Nextsense, Semos, Duna, Seavus and peers) with self-descriptions - the cheapest way to build the vendor actor map for banking/payments before hunting individual press rooms.

source_name: MASIT legacy site (oldmasit.masit.org.mk) — historical member list
why_relevant: Archived earlier generation of the MASIT member directory. Comparing old vs current membership reveals vendor entries/exits, renames and acquisitions in the MK ICT-to-banking supplier base over time.

source_name: MBA — Members directory (банки, штедилници, институции)
why_relevant: Single-page enumeration of the entire regulated deposit-taking sector: ~13-14 banks, 2 savings houses (Штедилница Можности, Штедилница ФУЛМ) plus KIBS AD Skopje (clearing/interbank systems) and Македонско кредитно биро. This is the seed actor list for every downstream A1 disclosure crawl.

source_name: MBA — Собрание и комисии (Assembly and standing commissions)
why_relevant: Lists MBA's permanent working bodies — payment systems, information security, risk management, liquidity, AML, document processing, securities, HR. The payment-systems and information-security commissions are the exact fora where card/ATM/e-banking/technology-vendor topics surface, and the named delegates map bank-side decision makers.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia member profiles (incl. Asseco SEE)
why_relevant: Confirms local legal presence of regional banking-software vendors in MK and gives contact/scope detail; complements MASIT for foreign-owned vendors that sell into MK banks.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia — member directory (CaSys and payment-sector members)
why_relevant: Business-chamber member profiles give current self-descriptions, leadership names and contact points for payment operators, and the wider directory enumerates adjacent fintech/vendor actors for snowballing.

source_name: IMF eLibrary — Staff Country Reports (North Macedonia series)
why_relevant: Structured, citable archive of the full MK staff-report series (incl. informational annexes and selected-issues papers) with stable volume/issue identifiers — better for back-filling history than the news pages.

source_name: thebanks.eu — North Macedonia bank profiles and rankings
why_relevant: English aggregator normalising MK bank balance-sheet data, ownership and rankings into comparable profiles — a fast actor-map builder, though derived and lagging; must be cross-checked against NBRNM/bank disclosures.

source_name: Економски факултет – Скопје (UKIM) — doctoral dissertations / theses PDF archive
why_relevant: MK doctoral theses on banking and payments contain reconstructed multi-year datasets and interview evidence not available anywhere else; the faculty publishes full-text PDFs under /wp-content/uploads/.

source_name: еМагазин archive (arhiva.emagazin.mk)
why_relevant: Historic archive of the same outlet — useful for reconstructing multi-year timelines of bank CEO changes and fee/tariff news that the live site no longer surfaces.

source_name: biznisregulativa.mk — chamber registry profile (МАСИТ and other комори)
why_relevant: Government-adjacent business-regulation portal that enumerates recognised chambers (комори) with profile pages. A compact way to obtain the authoritative list of chamber-type bodies in MK rather than assembling it ad hoc from search results.

source_name: Daily.mk — news aggregator
why_relevant: Second aggregator; indexed the Komercijalna Banka service-outage story. Useful redundancy against TIME.mk and a different outlet mix.

source_name: eCommerce4all.mk — MK e-payment landscape guide
why_relevant: Structured explainer of the MK e-payment stack: which processor runs the gateway and which banks provide acquiring. Efficient way to bootstrap the acquirer/PSP actor map and its aliases.

source_name: German-Macedonian Business Association (DMWV/МГСЗ) — member directory PDF
why_relevant: 200+ members; the largest bilateral business association in MK and strategic partner of AHK Nordmazedonien. The annually issued Mitgliederverzeichnis is a downloadable, machine-parsable member directory — an unusually clean pointer artefact. Trilingual context (de/mk/en).

source_name: GRID.mk — aggregator of MK portals and TV
why_relevant: Aggregates MK portals plus television output; historically indexed Komercijalna Banka technical-problem coverage. Broadcast coverage of bank incidents is otherwise hard to monitor.

source_name: OCP Data Registry — North Macedonia publication entry
why_relevant: Metadata pointer describing where MK contracting data comes from, its coverage window, format and download endpoints. Use it to decide whether bulk OCDS beats scraping, and to detect when coverage breaks.

source_name: Startup Macedonia — startup ecosystem platform
why_relevant: Data-driven registry of MK startups; the practical way to spot pre-licence payment/fintech startups and funding rounds before they reach trade press.

source_name: w3newspapers / World-Newspapers — MK media directories
why_relevant: Directory listings of Macedonian newspapers and news sites — a cheap way to enumerate outlets (including regional and smaller titles) that keyword search alone will not surface, for completing the media map.

source_name: АСЈИ / aspi.mk — Central Registry as a holder of public information (FOI route)
why_relevant: Lists ЦРРСМ as an information holder under the freedom-of-information law, with its designated officers. This is the formal escalation path when a needed aggregate (e.g. counts or lists of registered payment-services companies by activity code) is not offered as a product — a legal request route rather than a purchase.

source_name: Слободен пристап / АСПИ — FOI request platform and register of information holders
why_relevant: Freedom-of-information channel and register of all public information holders, including the Appeals Commission and BJN. Where a contract document is not published, an FOI request is the lawful retrieval route; the register itself is a clean actor map of public buyers.

entity_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија
source_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија (Macedonian Chambers of Commerce, MCC)
why_relevant: Second major chamber system (independent of mchamber.mk), described as connecting thousands of member companies to 1000+ national/regional institutions; signs bilateral memoranda (e.g. with the Croatian Chamber) and runs sectoral groupings. A parallel member universe worth diffing against Стопанска комора.

entity_name: Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија / Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë Veriperëndimore
source_name: Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија / Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë Veriperëndimore (OEMVP)
why_relevant: Regional/ethnic-Albanian business chamber (est. 2005, Skopje), publishing in Albanian and Macedonian. Covers a member base — including Albanian-owned SMEs banking with specific institutions — that the Skopje-centric chambers under-represent. Adds the sq language dimension to the MK association landscape.
